factors.prefix: teacher retains previous GT decision tokens during training; zero replaces every decision token in the model input by0 independently of GT. The separate target remains the actual20 labels. All inference uses the same zero-prefix scaffold.
factors.loss: Both factors supervise only20 binary decision positions using logits1-minus-logits0, conditional on those two tokens. Uniform weights every label equally. Balanced positive weight equals total negative/positive slots in the400 training sequences; normalize the weighted loss by weight mass per batch. No syntax-token loss in any of the four arms.

implementation: Use the original decoder hidden states and original vocabulary head, projecting only the20 decision-position hidden states before selecting0/1 logits. Before fitting, verify numerical equivalence with the full vocabulary forward pass on synthetic inputs. Verify teacher/zero target alignment, zero-prefix label blindness, weighting, finite gradients and complete batch/step exposure. No newly learned output head, arbitrary dose or fallback prescription.
inference: Score all20 positions in one forward pass with an all-zero decision scaffold. P(1)=softmax(logits0,logits1). Build orders from the fixed candidate catalogue. This is a language-backbone decision scorer with a deterministic compiler, not free generation.
calibration: Report both the fixed0.5 binary decision rule and a separately calibrated global threshold for every neural state, including base and original failed adapter. Grid0.01..0.99 by0.01; choose maximum average drug/core-order microF1 over the two proposal views, retaining the highest threshold on ties within1e-12. One threshold is shared across views; no fit or threshold uses guard labels. This ordinary calibration is explicitly separated from training gains.
